data: What is the range of the values of ELBO?

The range of the values of ELBO can be determined by looking at the y-axis labeled "ELBO" on the left side of the graph. The blue line represents the ELBO score for Ja-En dataset, and the red line represents the ELBO score for En-De dataset. The y-axis ranges from approximately -34 to -18. Therefore, the range of the values of ELBO is approximately -34 to -18.
